_comment: Clutter sets: clutter copied around each camp object. Offsets are in game units relative to the object (x = right, y = forward, which for tents is out of the entrance toward the fire; z = up). Rotation is in degrees (x, y, z). base is a vanilla or LazyCamping EditorID; use static clutter, not items that can be picked up. An item with "storage": true marks where the storage backpack goes instead of being copied.
